Website & pre-release information

A little clarity.

Updated 7 November 2026

Pupwell is not yet available for public download. These are website and preview-use terms. Final app terms and contact details will be published before release.

About this website

This website introduces Pupwell, a habit and wellbeing companion. Product illustrations and interactions demonstrate the experience. Features and availability may change before release. This website does not take payments or create a subscription.

Everyday wellbeing

Pupwell is designed for personal routines, focus and reflection. It is not medical care, therapy, diagnosis or emergency support, and does not guarantee a health or productivity result.

Your content

Your journal entries and voice recordings belong to you. You choose whether to export or share them. Connected features must not be used for harassment, unlawful content or infringement of another person's rights.

Local storage

Personal app history and recordings are stored locally in the current app. Losing a device, uninstalling the app or resetting app data can affect access. Exports are separate copies, not an automatic cloud backup. Do not rely on preview software as your only copy of important information.

Optional Pupwell Plus

The app will show the available features, complete price, billing period, renewal terms and any eligible trial before purchase. Subscriptions are managed through your App Store account. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription. Both people currently need their own Plus membership to use a Friends connection.

Our artwork

The Pupwell name, artwork and website materials are provided to explain the product. Please do not present them as your own product or imply an endorsement. Font licenses are included with the website assets.

Contact & release information

For questions, email hello@trypupwell.app. Final operator details and applicable app-specific terms will be published before launch. The current website is a pre-release introduction, not an offer to purchase.

Read the privacy information or visit Support.
